release.content: pubhost 0.1.1 was released on 2026-11-12 from commit 6c14cb03c86a46e6be5800ca913eb48e6e0ab0cd with these changes.

rows: hosting.yml's terraform init runs through pubkit's actions/terraform-init (pubkit 0.35.1) in place of its own retry loop, with the same three tries 10 s apart; pubhost moves to pubkit 0.35.1
dns-zone works with cloudflare provider 5.29, which dropped foundation_dns from cloudflare_zone_dns_settings; the modules now require ~> 5.29
terraform.yml takes a runs-on input, the runner label its plan and apply jobs run on (ubuntu-latest by default), so a stack with self-hosted runners applies on them

release.scope: the published release v0.1.1 of pubhost
